en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy town square with tram tracks, horse‑drawn carts, pedestrians and trees. Dominating the scene is a large domed church with a cross on top and an attached bell tower, along with a tall column or monument in the center of the square. The caption at the bottom names the place and the church. The reverse side is a typical divided postcard back with address lines and a printed indication of rights and the year 1927 by the Budapest publisher Barasits.
